subsystem.name: MathAndCollision
subsystem.responsibility: Packed-SIMD (3DNow!) matrix math, scene-culling sphere/frustum tests and spatial nearest-object queries, vehicle constraint-solver math, and rotation/Euler-angle helpers. The packet also contains eight address-clustered generic runtime utilities (counted-array destruction, socket-array teardown, array access/search, critical-section init, bit/zero helpers) that are grouped by address proximity rather than by subsystem affinity and are not claimed as math-and-collision members.

summary: 22 functions in three coherent clusters plus a tail of address-clustered utilities. Cluster A: 3DNow! packed-float matrix math (0x00522B5B 3x3 inverse, 0x00523E7A quaternion-to-matrix, 0x005257C0/0x00525E9A determinant-guarded 4x4 inversions, 0x00525AA2 4x4 multiply) written against eight __m64 quads at 0x0..0x38 with homogeneous last row {0,1.0}, sharing packed constants 0x005AF8F0/0x005AF900/0x005AF920/0x005AF990. Cluster B: scene culling (0x00549FB0 sphere-vs-frustum test writing status bits in this+0x4; 0x0054A340 spatial-tree nearest-object query with the shared bounding-sphere layout center +0x7C/0x80/0x84, radius +0x18). Cluster C: vehicle physics constraint math (VehicleConstraintSolver 0x0056A5D0 velocity processing and 0x0056B5D0 sparse stiffness-matrix assembly; 0x00569B70 impulse/momentum subtraction; rotation/Euler helpers 0x005670D0, 0x005674C0, 0x0056C2D0). The remaining eight functions (0x00550820, 0x00563DC0, 0x00563E80, 0x00564AB0, 0x0058DFC1, 0x0058FF0D, 0x0059525D, 0x00595310) are generic utilities; 0x00528F00 has an empty body.

function_roles.role: 3DNow! inverse of the 3x3 rotation submatrix into eight __m64 output quads; homogeneous last row {0,1.0}; whether the result is a true inverse or an adjugate is unresolved
Multiply two packed-float quaternions (scaled by 0.5) and convert the product to a 4x4 rotation matrix via cofactor/adjugate pattern
Determinant-guarded 4x4 matrix inversion via 3DNow cofactors; optional determinant int output through a2; singular path skips the store and returns nonzero
3DNow! 4x4 matrix multiply with a specialized in-place (a2 == a1) path
3DNow! 4x4 inverse operator; accumulates a scalar (exposed through a2 when non-null), returns 0 on the invertible path and -1 when the scalar is zero (output untouched)
Empty-body stub in the SIMD vector-normalization path; the nine referenced read-only globals near 0x005D9358 are not exercised by any visible code
Sphere-vs-frustum visibility test: force-hidden mask short-circuit, sphere-distance prune, six-plane loop, visibility status written into low bits of this+0x4
Nearest-object query against a bounding-sphere spatial tree with 6-plane frustum acceptance; fallback linear walk of an inline linked list when the tree root is absent; cached result at this+0x1A4
Counted-array destructor: backward-destroys 8-byte-stride elements via 0x00550810 then frees the allocation including the count prefix via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Close every socket in a network socket array (28-byte stride, handle at entry offset 0, count at this+0x6C)
Bounds-checked array element read: validates index against count query 0x00563E70 and resolves the element via LinearInterpolation 0x005648B0; 0 on out-of-range
Callback-driven linear scan over up to a3 elements with stride a4; returns first element for which callback a5 returns zero, else 0
Fill a 3x3 rotation matrix (float, 4-byte stride) from two Euler-angle arguments; middle entry forced to zero
Rotate the first two columns of a 3x3 matrix by an angle and extract Euler angles (pitch, yaw, roll) with a gimbal-lock branch on fabs(center element) == 1.0
Subtract an impulse vector from linear momentum (this+0x134/0x13C/0x144) and lever-arm cross-product components from angular momentum (this+0x14C/0x154/0x15C); returns the impulse pointer
Process joint constraint velocity vectors into a body-id-indexed force buffer at this+0x224 (Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, CrossProductNormalize, traction constants 0x005E5238/0x005E5240)

Assemble the sparse symmetric constraint stiffness matrix from joint (stride 132) and contact (stride 88) entries into the row-pointer table at this+0x228 using world-space inverse inertia at this+0xEC..0x12C
Rotate columns 1 and 2 of a 3x3 double matrix around the X axis and optionally extract Euler angles (gimbal-lock aware) into a3
Startup-only straight-line initializer of four Win32 critical-section globals (0x005E6CC4, 0x005E6CB4, 0x005E6CA4, 0x005E6C84) via InitializeCriticalSection
Binary search over 8-byte key/value records using comparator 0x00588410; on hit writes the record value field (base+4) into *a3 and returns the comparator result
Clear one bit in a bit array (word a2/32, bit a2%32), invoke failure handler 0x00595207 if the trailing range was not clear, and zero-fill words beyond the target when before the third word
Test whether three consecutive dwords are all zero; return 1 only when the counter reaches 3

classes.name: Matrix3x3Util
classes.responsibility: 3x3 rotation-matrix fill from Euler angles; plain matrix utility with no class-identity evidence beyond its two suspension/wheel callers.

classes.name: EulerAngleMatrixRotation
classes.responsibility: Column-rotation and Euler-angle extraction on 3x3 double matrices, with a gimbal-lock branch comparing the center-column element against the dbl_59E420 constant and FloatConvertWrapper before angle output. Element layout is an 8-byte double matrix; only the offsets evidenced here are claimed.

classes.name: VehicleConstraintSolver
classes.responsibility: Vehicle physics constraint solver. Processes joint constraint velocity vectors into a body-id-indexed force buffer and assembles the sparse symmetric constraint stiffness matrix from joint/contact entries using the world-space inverse inertia tensor.

classes.name: RigidBodyImpulseState
classes.responsibility: Rigid-body linear and angular momentum state modified by impulse subtraction with lever-arm cross-product terms. Field semantics (momentum) are DERIVED from the arithmetic shape and the subtraction twin pattern; the owner is otherwise unknown.

classes.name: FrustumCullableObject
classes.responsibility: Scene object carrying a bounding sphere and visibility status bits, tested against a caller-supplied 6-plane view frustum. Plane data lives in the caller's frustum argument, not on this object.

classes.name: SpatialTreeQuery
classes.responsibility: Spatial query container that finds the nearest object to a negated query point passing a 6-plane frustum test, walking either a bounding-sphere spatial tree rooted at this+0x2A0 or, when absent, a fallback inline linked list headed at this+0x100; best result cached at this+0x1A4. Inline list nodes and tree children share a bounding-sphere layout (radius +0x18, center +0x7C/0x80/0x84, plane data +0x8C/0x90/0x94).

classes.name: NetworkSocketContainer
classes.responsibility: Container for a network socket array (base this+0x8, count this+0x6C, 28-byte entries with the handle at entry offset 0) whose teardown closes every socket.

interfaces.name: SIMDMatrixMath
interfaces.purpose: Pack of 3DNow!-intrinsic free functions implementing 4x4 multiply and inverse and quaternion-to-matrix conversion over eight __m64 packed-float quads (offsets 0x0..0x38), slot 6 zeroed and slot 7 the {0,1.0} homogeneous row. Shared packed constants at 0x005AF8F0 (packed -1.0/1.0), 0x005AF900 (packed 0.5 and 1.0), 0x005AF920 (sign-flip mask) and 0x005AF990 (packed 1.0). Owner classes are unknown; the grouping rests on the shared intrinsic pattern and constants.

interfaces.name: ArraySearchAndMutation
interfaces.purpose: Generic bounded-array access and search primitives: binary search over 8-byte key/value records, callback-driven stride scan, and bounds-checked indexed read. No class identity is evidenced; consumers sit in network/session paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: MatrixEightPackedQuadLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: 3DNow matrix routines read and write a 4x4 matrix as eight 64-bit packed-float quads at byte offsets 0x0..0x38, with slot 6 zeroed and slot 7 holding the homogeneous row {0, 1.0}. A replacement must preserve this eight-quad layout for both the SIMDMatrixMath set and any consumer of the produced inverse/multiply output.

compatibility_contracts.name: SingularMatrixInverseReturnContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The 4x4 inversions (0x005257C0, 0x00525E9A) skip writing the output matrix when the accumulated determinant/scalar is zero, return 0 on the invertible path and a nonzero value (0x00525E9A returns -1) on the singular path, and write the determinant/scalar into the optional out-pointer a2 only when a2 is non-null.

compatibility_contracts.name: BoundingSphereLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Culling and spatial-query objects share a bounding-sphere layout: radius at +0x18, sphere center at +0x7C/+0x80/+0x84, and 6-plane frustum coefficients at +0x8C/+0x90/+0x94. The shared offsets across the culling test, the spatial-tree children and the inline list nodes are the observable contract a spatial rewrite must preserve.

compatibility_contracts.name: FrustumVisibilityStatusBits
compatibility_contracts.description: Sphere-vs-frustum visibility is recorded in the low status bits of the flags dword at this+0x4 (force-hidden mask 0x50 short-circuits to culled; bit semantics for visible/culled/partial/sphere-culled are inferred from branch structure, not independently confirmed). Callers of 0x00549FB0 must observe the same bit contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConstraintMatrixRowPointerIndexing
compatibility_contracts.description: The constraint solver indexes the sparse symmetric stiffness matrix by body id through the row-pointer table at this+0x228, accumulating inverse-inertia-weighted 3x3 blocks for joint (stride 132) and contact (stride 88) entries with add/subtract selected by the sign byte. A replacement solver must reproduce this body-id row-pointer indexing and block accumulation.

unresolved: The packet mixes genuine math-and-collision work with eight address-clustered generic utilities (counted-array destructor 0x00550820, socket teardown 0x00563DC0, array read 0x00563E80, array scan 0x00564AB0, critical-section init 0x0058DFC1, binary search 0x0058FF0D, bit-clear 0x0059525D, zero check 0x00595310). These are grouped by address proximity, not subsystem affinity; their owner objects are unknown.

0x00528F00 has an empty body ('void sub_528F00() { ; }'); the nine read-only globals 0x005D9358..0x005D93B8 it is reported to reference (DERIVED as SIMD math coefficient tables) are not exercised by any visible code and the canonical name F_3DVectorNormalize_8f00 cannot be confirmed.

0x00522B5B: whether the 3x3 routine computes a true inverse or an adjugate/cofactor result without a final division is not established; the packed lane layout of the inverse across the eight __m64 slots is inferred from punpck order, not verified against a consumer.
Read-only qword 0x005AF8F0 is reported by deterministic facts but the decompiled bodies render the constant inline (packed -1.0f/1.0f); the exact global-to-constant mapping is not established.

0x0054A340: the read-only global dbl_59E430 is listed as read but does not appear in the raw pseudocode (constant may be folded into the FLT_MAX sentinel 9.9999997e37), and the residual CPU-status-flag guard (c0/c3) gating the cached-result early return cannot be reconstructed into a source-level comparison.

0x00549FB0: the frustum argument a2 layout (bounding radius at a2[2], sphere offset at a2[9..11], plane block at a2+65) is caller-defined; the visibility-flag bit semantics beyond the force-hidden 0x50 mask are inferred from the branch structure.

VehicleConstraintSolver: the exact packing of the 3x3 block within each per-body row block, the force-buffer stride and the two double slots per body, and the add-versus-subtract sign-byte semantics (shared/opposed body frame) are inferred, not proven.
0x00523E7A: exact quaternion convention (component order and sign convention of the encoded a2/a3 operands) is not pinned down.

Ownership is unknown for most functions; only Matrix3x3Util and VehicleConstraintSolver carry a DERIVED owner in the packet, and the GUESS classes EulerAngleMatrixRotation, RigidBodyImpulseState, FrustumCullableObject, SpatialTreeQuery and NetworkSocketContainer are grouping proposals, not recovered class identities.

Equal byte offsets on different 'this' bases are not merged unless common ownership is proven: e.g. +0x7C/+0x84 are the culling sphere center on FrustumCullableObject but angular-velocity doubles on VehicleConstraintSolver, and +0x104 is the fallback-list entry on SpatialTreeQuery but invInertia[1][0] on VehicleConstraintSolver.

0x00569B70: the interpretation of this+0x134..0x15C as linear/angular momentum and of a2 as a lever-arm vector is DERIVED from the arithmetic shape and the structural-twin prelabel, not from packet field names; the mixed cross-product sign convention is unexplained.
0x00525E9A: the field R/W classification (0x0 RW, 0x8..0x38 R) recorded by the extractor does not match the unconditional writes to all eight output qwords; the discrepancy is kept as-is.
The trailing stub call target of 0x00550820 and the 28-byte socket entry tail (bytes 4..27) of 0x00563DC0 are not described by the packet.
